Class CockroachDBContinuumCloudActuatorAutoConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.cockroachlabs.data.continuum.cloud.autoconfigure.CockroachDBContinuumCloudActuatorAutoConfiguration
@AutoConfiguration(after=CockroachDBContinuumCloudAutoConfiguration.class) @ConditionalOnClass(name={"org.springframework.boot.actuate.endpoint.annotation.Endpoint","org.springframework.boot.health.contributor.HealthIndicator"}) @ConditionalOnBean(CloudClient.class) public class CockroachDBContinuumCloudActuatorAutoConfiguration extends Object
Registers the Continuum Cloud Actuator surfaces (/actuator/continuum endpoint and a health indicator) when Spring Boot Actuator and the health contributor API are on the classpath and a CloudClient bean exists.

Class presence is checked by name so this configuration loads harmlessly in apps without Actuator.
